evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies TxDownloadManager, TxOrphanage, and net_processing to handle orphan resolution and missing parent downloads.
rationale: Fixes four transaction relay edge cases where a peer sending a same-txid variant can poison reject filters, evict valid orphan children, or stall opportunistic 1P1C package propagation. Stalling CPFP package resolution until parent confirmation or re-announcement is a meaningful transaction relay defect that warrants deliberate review.
